cases.note: An annotation whose argument list spans lines is one annotation, and the declaration's preamble reads through it: the loaders' walk used to stop at its continuation lines and cut every annotation above it out of the slice, refusing this prompt as declaring no level (memql#5426).

cases.message: @level on a prompt takes one string
unknown level "medium": a level is one of fast, strong, reasoning, embeddings

cases.note: Every prompt declares its level: the router's rules branch on it, and a prompt never names a model (epic memql#5127). The parser leaves an absent @level empty and the loader refuses it, so strict boot does and a bundle mounted at MEMQL_DSL_PATH is held to it too (memql#5426).
